label: Landscapes & Geography
descriptionVi: Từ vựng về địa hình, đất đai, sông ngòi, núi non và cảnh quan thiên nhiên.

words.vi: đất đai, vùng đất, mặt đất
words.senseNote: Phần bề mặt rắn của trái đất không bị bao phủ bởi nước biển hay sông hồ

examples.en: After three weeks at sea, the sailors finally saw land ahead.

words.vi: của, từ (trong địa danh)

examples.en: Rio de Janeiro is famous for its breathtaking coastal mountains and sandy beaches.

examples.en: They took a scenic ferry ride to reach the quiet neighboring island.
examples.vi: Họ đi một chuyến phà ngắm cảnh tuyệt đẹp để sang hòn đảo lân cận yên bình.

words.vi: dòng sông, con sông

words.vi: biển cả, đại dương
words.senseNote: Vùng nước mặn bao la nối liền các đại dương bao quanh lục địa

examples.vi: Vùng biển xanh êm dịu trông đẹp ngỡ ngàng dưới ánh nắng ban mai rực rỡ.

examples.en: A winding clear brook flows gently through the sheltered wooded dale toward the river.

examples.en: Scientists conduct international climate research on expanding ice sheets in the remote polar regions.

examples.en: Severe polar vortex winds brought subzero temperatures across the northern hemisphere.
examples.vi: Những cơn gió xoáy cực khắc nghiệt đã mang lại nhiệt độ dưới 0 độ C trên khắp bán cầu bắc.

examples.en: Environmental volunteers mobilized quickly along the rocky shoreline to clean up a hazardous oil spill.

examples.en: A sudden chemical spill near the river prompted emergency containment barriers from environmental agencies.

words.vi: dưới mặt nước; ngập nước

examples.vi: Các nhà sinh vật biển đã thám hiểm một rạn san hô dưới nước rực rỡ tràn ngập cá nhiệt đới và san hô đầy màu sắc.

examples.en: Divers used specialized underwater cameras to photograph ancient sunken ruins.
examples.vi: Các thợ lặn đã sử dụng máy ảnh dưới nước chuyên dụng để chụp ảnh các tàn tích cổ xưa bị chìm.

examples.en: Children love to wade in the gentle ocean waves along the warm sandy shoreline.

examples.en: A passenger ferry transports island commuters back and forth to the mainland every hour.

examples.en: The modern suspension bridge connects the remote coastal archipelago directly to the mainland.

examples.en: The coastal train route is famous for its stunning ocean views and rugged cliff scenery.
examples.vi: Tuyến tàu hỏa ven biển nổi tiếng với tầm nhìn ra đại dương tuyệt đẹp và phong cảnh vách đá gồ ghề.

examples.en: Hikers rested on mossy boulders along the quiet glen, listening to songbirds nesting in the birch trees.

examples.en: Wooden boardwalks allow nature enthusiasts to hike safely above the muddy wetland marsh.
examples.vi: Những con đường lát ván gỗ cho phép người yêu thiên nhiên đi bộ an toàn bên trên vùng đầm lầy ngập nước đầy bùn.

examples.en: Heavy seasonal rains filled the hydroelectric reservoir to its maximum operational capacity.
examples.vi: Những cơn mưa lớn theo mùa đã làm đầy hồ chứa thủy điện đến dung tích vận hành tối đa.

examples.en: Protected wildlife sanctuaries preserve the delicate freshwater swamp ecosystem from industrial development.
examples.vi: Các khu bảo tồn động vật hoang dã được bảo vệ giữ gìn hệ sinh thái đầm lầy nước ngọt mong manh khỏi sự phát triển công nghiệp.

examples.en: The specialized laboratory analyzed the extracted uranium ore to determine its purity.
examples.vi: Phòng thí nghiệm chuyên dụng đã phân tích quặng urani vừa khai thác để xác định độ tinh khiết của nó.

passages.title: Exploring the Great Valley
passages.text: Last summer, my family traveled across a magnificent green land filled with natural wonders. We began our morning journey near a traditional family farm nestled below a steep hill. Happy animals grazed peacefully in the open pastures. Soft yellow wildflowers covered the damp ground, and fresh salty breezes blew from the distant blue sea. We followed a quiet dirt path that led up toward a towering mountain covered in thick pine forests. From the high ridge, we looked down upon a wide sparkling river that wound gracefully through the entire valley. A historic arched bridge made of solid grey stone connected the two peaceful banks. Across the river, there was a small green island where wild birds made their nests safely among the reeds. Our friendly guide, an experienced explorer from Bahia de Banderas, told us fascinating stories about the local geography. As we continued walking along the rocky mountain trail, we heard a thunderous roar echoing through the trees. Suddenly, we arrived at the breathtaking falls, where cool crystal water plunged dramatically down into a deep blue pool. White mist rose softly into the bright sunshine, creating vibrant rainbows above the splashing water. We sat down on a smooth stone bench to rest our feet and enjoy our picnic lunch together. Watching the rushing river continue its journey toward the ocean reminded us how precious our planet is. We took dozens of memorable photographs before slowly walking back across the bridge. It was truly an unforgettable day spent admiring the beauty of nature.

passages.titleVi: Khám phá thung lũng vĩ đại

passages.title: From the Mountain Heights to the Coastal Delta
passages.text: Exploring diverse geographical landscapes provides profound insight into how natural forces sculpt our planet. Last week, our geography club embarked on an expedition spanning mountain ridges and coastal lowlands. We began our ascent early in the morning, climbing up to the panoramic heights where cold winds sweep across rocky ledges. Standing at the high summit, we observed the natural boundary separating the alpine pine forest from open grasslands below. In the upper valley, gravity relentlessly pulls rainwater downward, feeding sparkling streams that nourish thousands of fertile acres of rural countryside. Near a shaded hillside pasture, wild rabbits scurried into an underground earthen warren beneath the thick turf. As we followed the river downstream, the water widened into a tranquil lowland delta where floating water lilies blossomed across calm channels. Looking westward toward the horizon, the expansive river emptied into a sheltered coastal gulf. Along the sunny costa, gentle ocean waves washed against the sandy shore, creating a soothing maritime rhythm. Walking along the breeze-swept coast, we admired how geological features transition seamlessly from towering cliffs to tidal estuaries. Understanding geography enriches our awareness of environmental interconnections and climate systems. When travelers observe how gravity, water flow, and coastal terrain interact, they develop deep reverence for the natural world. Each distinct ecological zone, from mountain crags to coastal mudflats, provides vital sanctuary for native wildlife and migratory birds. Experiencing these magnificent outdoor environments first-hand inspires a lifelong commitment to conservation and sustainable stewardship. Preserving these diverse landscapes ensures that future generations can witness the majestic interplay of earth and water.

passages.title: The Wonders of Our Natural Planet
passages.text: Our vast blue planet is home to an extraordinary variety of geological wonders and pristine landscapes. Walking along a winding dirt path through the countryside allows travelers to connect deeply with living nature. In the highland interior, fertile soils of the river valley support lush green meadows and ancient pine forests. High above the lowlands, monumental walls of solid grey rock rise steeply toward clear blue skies, sheltering the mountain basin from harsh continental winds. Nestled between rolling alpine hills, a tranquil freshwater lake reflects the drifting clouds like a polished mirror. As glacial streams cascade downward, they nourish the rich, moist earth where native wildflowers bloom each spring. Following the waterway further toward the coast, travelers encounter a serene sheltered bay where fishing boats rest safely at anchor. Here, the soothing rhythm of each incoming ocean wave washes over smooth pebbles and sandy shores. Observing how water, stone, and soil interact creates a profound sense of wonder in every explorer. Preserving the natural equilibrium of these scenic habitats is essential for sustaining biodiversity worldwide. When communities value and protect their surrounding environment, local flora and fauna flourish across every continent. Everyone who explores the great outdoors learns that caring for the earth ensures a healthy future for the next generation. From mountain summits to coastal coves, our planet offers endless breathtaking discoveries for those who cherish its timeless harmony. Exploring these diverse terrains inspires deep respect for the ancient forces that shaped our continents. Protecting these pristine wilderness sanctuaries ensures that future generations will experience the awe of untouched nature.

passages.title: Natural Contrasts Across the Continental Wilderness
passages.titleVi: Những nét tương phản tự nhiên khắp miền hoang dã lục địa
passages.text: Exploring the breathtaking natural geography of our vast continent reveals dramatic geological contrasts across every ecological region. Last summer, our educational geography expedition traveled westward toward the expansive coastline of the deep blue Pacific Ocean. Our journey began in a sun-drenched arid desert, where towering saguaro cactus cast long, slender shadows across dry gravel flats. In the intense midday heat, the liquid mercury in our field thermometer climbed above forty degrees Celsius, reminding travelers of the extreme climate endured by resilient desert wildlife. Continuing north, the desolate desert basin yielded to the majestic snow-capped peaks of the rugged western sierra. Nestled deep within a mountain canyon, engineers had constructed a massive concrete dam that reservoirs fresh river water to nourish agricultural valleys below. In the lush foothills beneath the mountain range, we visited a historic family cattle ranch, where horses and livestock grazed peacefully across green pastures. Finally, the winding mountain highway descended toward the breezy ocean shore. Gentle ocean waves rolled rhythmically across a wide sandy beach, creating fine sea mist in the afternoon air. Standing on the coastal bluffs, we watched the golden sun illuminate the distant Pacific horizon. Each distinct natural landscape—from scorching desert basins to towering sierra peaks and breezy ocean shores—illustrates the powerful forces shaping our continent. Traveling across diverse geographical terrain teaches explorers to respect the delicate balance connecting water, stone, and climate. Protecting these majestic wilderness habitats guarantees that future generations can experience the profound wonder of our natural planet. Every natural wonder reminds humanity to walk gently upon the Earth with gratitude.

passages.title: Journey Across Pristine Lakes and Coastal Landscapes
passages.titleVi: Hành trình qua những hồ nước nguyên sơ và cảnh quan ven biển
passages.text: Exploring diverse geographical terrain allows nature enthusiasts to discover how freshwater waterways and rugged coastal landforms shape regional ecology. Early yesterday morning, our environmental research group departed the bustling mainland by passenger ferry to survey a remote coastal peninsula. From the scenic ferry deck, travelers admired breathtaking ocean scenery as gentle morning mist hovered over towering grey granite cliffs. Upon arrival, we hiked inland through a quiet wooded glen where cold mountain streams tumble over mossy stones. A well-engineered drainage ditch along the dirt pathway channels excess spring rainwater to prevent soil erosion. High above the valley floor sits a massive alpine reservoir that stores pure drinking water for thousands of nearby families. Our guide explained how strict conservation safeguards ensure that no chemical spill or industrial pollutant ever contaminates the pristine watershed. Later in the afternoon, the mountain trail descended toward a wide coastal saltwater marsh teeming with native wildlife. Flocks of white egrets and wild ducks hunted small fish among tall wetland reeds. To reach a secluded sandy cove, hikers had to wade carefully across a shallow tidal inlet with rolled-up trousers. At the water's edge, marine biologists put on diving masks to inspect vibrant underwater kelp forests and rocky reefs. Standing along the serene shoreline, we watched the golden sun illuminate distant sea bluffs. Local rangers organize seasonal volunteer expeditions to clear brush and monitor native plant biodiversity across the hillsides. Such meaningful fieldwork reminds us that community stewardship is vital for safeguarding our precious natural heritage. Preserving these interconnected watersheds and coastal ecosystems ensures that pure water, thriving wildlife, and magnificent natural geography endure for future generations.

passages.title: Geological Diversity Across the Coastal Highland
passages.titleVi: Sự đa dạng địa chất trên khắp vùng cao nguyên ven biển
passages.text: Our expedition team spent a remarkable week surveying the rugged landscapes of the northern coastal highland. From the base of the steep mount, we hiked across broad stretches of open prairie covered in wild grasses. In the distance, green rolling hills stretched toward the horizon, dotted with patches of dense arid scrub. Along the valley floor, a clear freshwater stream flowed briskly over smooth pebbles and sparkling veins of white quartz. Geologists carefully chipped away brittle fragments of dark grey shale to uncover fossilized marine organisms preserved for millions of years. Every tidal inlet near the rocky coastline revealed shallow saltwater pools teeming with miniature crabs and sea anemones. As we climbed higher through the dense pine woods, we navigated around massive fallen logs that had tumbled during winter storms. A gigantic granite boulder perched precariously near the canyon edge served as an ideal observation point for our geological sketches. The panoramic vistas from this elevation highlighted how natural weathering continuously shapes regional terrain. Environmental scientists continue to study these distinct ecosystems to safeguard fragile habitats from soil erosion and human encroachment. Preserving such unique geographical regions ensures that future generations can explore and appreciate our planet's ancient natural wonders. Local park rangers routinely inspect marked pathways to prevent hikers from wandering onto unstable scree slopes. During early autumn mornings, thick ocean mist rolls quietly over the cliffs, coating the mountain vegetation in sparkling dew. Every team member recorded extensive field measurements into waterproof notebooks before setting up base camp for the night. These comprehensive geological surveys deepen our collective understanding of Earth's dynamic crustal shifts throughout deep historical time.

passages.title: Exploring the Diverse Terrains of the Great Continental Divide
passages.text:
The vast continental wilderness contains some of the most spectacular geological formations on Earth, spanning magnificent rolling valleys and towering snow-capped peaks. High in the northern highlands, rugged mountain ridges rise sharply toward crystal-clear skies above a tranquil, pristine alpine environment. Adventurous hikers traversing the steep mountain slope frequently pause to admire the sweeping panoramic horizon and breathe the invigorating fresh air. In the distance, an ancient elevated plateau stretches outward for dozens of miles, creating a breathtaking flat expanse that contrasts dramatically with jagged rocky cliffs.

Descending carefully toward lower elevations, adventurous travelers discover a sheltered green vale carved gradually over millions of years by natural water erosion. Here, an expansive sunlit meadow blooms vibrantly with native wildflowers, providing a thriving sanctuary for humming bees, colorful butterflies, and grazing wildlife. Nearby, a distinct rounded mound marks the historical site of an ancient geological ridge shaped continuously by powerful prehistoric winds. Bordering the open grassland, a dense pine woodland offers welcoming shade while its complex root systems protect fragile topsoil from severe weathering.

Further downstream along the winding river, clear mineral-rich waters flow steadily into a wide agricultural basin surrounded by gentle hills. This expansive lowland region boasts remarkably fertile soil that generations of dedicated farming families have cultivated with sustainable harvesting methods. The constant freshwater supply sustains flourishing rural communities that take immense pride in preserving their unique, unspoiled natural surroundings. By examining these magnificent geological landscapes, modern scientists and visitors gain a profound appreciation for nature's enduring power and ecological diversity.
